significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish both a phenomenon and mechanism: jailbreaks leave harm evidence "distributed across many earlier token positions" while disrupting its routing to "the final-position read-out," yielding a measurable positional coupling and a causal representation-versus-aggregation decomposition rather than merely another harm direction. This is form (iii) insofar as it predicts an ordering across positions and attack conditions, reinforced by form-(ii) causality: it fixes expectations about where harm remains decodable and explains why refusal fails across several attack classes; this would materially alter how the refusal direction characterized by Arditi et al. (2024) is interpreted. Verified false would distinguish representation-defeating attacks from the proposed read-out-defeating account and rule out aggregation failure as a broad explanation, although qualifiers such as "largely" and "essentially" make the boundary somewhat less sharp. The topic-substitution check passes: generic mechanistic LLM safety would not merit this score; the above-median value comes specifically from the claim's non-unitary causal decomposition and position-dependent relation.

reach.justification: The named handle is a "distributed-aggregation monitor" that pools latent harm signal "across ALL prompt positions," providing an ex-ante input diagnostic that could gate generation before a jailbroken response is produced. After per-model re-extraction, the claim predicts more than a search procedure: harmful-token projections should remain elevated while the final-position projection collapses, so the substantive positional relation—and not necessarily the numerical direction—should transfer. The asserted scope covers several jailbreak families and safety-aligned LLMs, with the explicit limitation that frontier-model transfer is untested; downstream users could include researchers as well as practitioners deploying input monitors or guardrails. The topic-substitution check passes because generic safety interpretability supplies neither this position-aggregating handle nor its lead time, and those claim-specific properties justify reach above the topic median.
